title: Two English Girls
writer: Henri-Pierre Roché, François Truffaut, Jean Gruault
actors: Jean-Pierre Léaud, Kika Markham, Stacey Tendeter
plot: Young Frenchman Claude meets Englishwoman Ann in Paris. Ann invites him to her family home, intending him for her sister Muriel. Claude falls for Muriel, but families demand year-long separation before approving marriage.
